author: NETWORG
name: Power Platform: Plugin Assembly
description: Manual registration of a plugin assembly in a solution. Script-only. Generates PluginAssemblies/{Name}-{GUID}/*.dll.data.xml. NOT needed by default: a pp-solution project with GeneratePluginAssembly=true (the default) registers every referenced plugin project on build. Use only when the solution sets GeneratePluginAssembly=false, or once before the solution's first build to fix the assembly id. Never run it after a build has registered the assembly (it adds a second type-91 root component and the next build fails), and never in a solution that declares steps with [PluginStep] attributes. CHAIN: manual path only — run in the target solution after pp-plugin. pp-plugin-assembly-step needs the registration to exist, however it was created.

AssemblyId.description: Unique GUID identifier for the plugin assembly

PluginProjectRootPath.description: Path to the plugin project root directory containing the compiled assembly

SolutionRootPath.description: Relative path from the project folder (.csproj) to the folder containing unpacked Dataverse solution files (Other/, Entities/, OptionSets/). Use '.' if solution files are directly in the project folder, or a subfolder name like 'Declarations'. Do not use 'Entities' or 'Other' — those are subdirectories inside the solution metadata root.
